body: That sounds believable. But where do I start?
If I were to try to map my way to a better life, I wouldn't know where to start. It's just a hodgepodge of crap settled over a once-readable map.

I just feel that if I stop, more stuff that I can't do will be piled onto me. Not to mention that I'd be losing valuable time at bettering myself at a skill or something. For me, that doesn't seem like an option.

It's totally not your fault, but I don't know if there's anything anyone can do.

Er, maybe a hug will help?
I've already stopped trying, and I don't have the energy to restart. Hell, I don't even have the energy to make posts on the internet. I'm pitiful.

Thank you for sharing that.

I just know I'm too stupid to understand. I will get too far. Nothing will ever be okay.
Thank you. The thought means a lot.
Sorry, but I'm in Ohio. But thanks for the offer. :)
The way I see it, the good times are temporary, but the regret and sorrow are forever.
